decisions.reason: The source explicitly sets internal-link destinations, but the candidate already contains a complete same-message MODIFY covering site products and related blogs.
Adding images and internal links to one blog does not change the required article count or general article-production obligation.
The source requests content additions but does not change the publication destination or publication unit.
The image and internal-link instructions do not alter the AI-dolls blog's target audience.
The source requests additions to the blog but neither grants publication authorization nor changes the existing approval gate.
The source does not add, replace, or remove any blog keyword target.
The source does not change the website SEO keyword count or replacement keyword.
The blog image and linking instructions do not change webpage replacement terms or their replacement scope.
Internal links within the blog are distinct from the off-page backlink campaign and do not change its count or link-type distribution.
Requesting three to four blog images does not specify or change ALT-text requirements for those images.
The source contains no decision about search-volume data in the keyword list.
The requested blog images and internal links do not affect H1 usage or heading hierarchy.
